description: Qualitative fluid p-V regions. Preserve solid critical isotherm C-K/right branch, dashed endpoint boundaries A-K/B-K, all named points and four source texture roles. Liquid, Liquid + saturated vapor, Unsaturated vapor and Gas have English labels. No calibrated readings or solid-state/general phase diagram claim.

authoritativeText.text:
40. 气体和液体平衡态的图线

回看真实气体的等温线图55，比较同一种纯物质、固定总质量在不同温度下的平衡状态。
把低于临界温度的各等温线水平段左端连接起来，也就是连接凝结刚结束、开始压缩液体的状态点，得到终止于临界点 $K$ 的平滑曲线。
这条边界在图 $57$ 中用虚线表示。

原书把这条虚线左侧与临界等温线的 $CK$ 段之间的区域标为液态区，即图 $57$ 中的水平细线条区域。
这里讨论的是图示液汽转变涉及的流体状态，不把这张图当作包括固态在内的全部物态图。
其中一个平衡状态点对应压强 $P$、总体积 $V$ 和温度 $T$，温度由相应等温线确定；

这些参量并不是可以互不相关地任意选取的。



图 57

把各等温线水平共存段的右端，即蒸汽刚开始凝结的状态点连接起来，得到另一条平滑虚线，也终止于临界点 $K$。
两条虚线 $AK$ 和 $BK$ 围成液体与饱和汽的平衡区域，对应图 $57$ 中的竖直细线条区域。
区域内部的点表示液汽两相共存，边界点表示其中一相刚出现或刚消失，临界端点处两相的区别消失。

两相的总质量固定，但液体和蒸汽各自的质量、所占体积可以随平衡状态改变。
图中的总体积包括两相体积，不能把整个共存区域都按质量固定的单一气相处理。

在本课相图所讨论的流体状态范围内，原书把液态区和液汽共存区之外的部分归入气态。
临界等温线下方、共存区右侧的未饱和蒸汽，可在温度不变并压缩到相应共存条件时开始凝结，再继续凝结成液体。
这种汽称为未饱和汽，图 $57$ 用斜细线条表示相应区域。

临界温度以上的单相流体不属于这种能够靠等温压缩发生两相凝结的未饱和汽。
当 $T>T_{\text{临}}$ 时，只有在密度足够低、分子相互作用影响较小的条件下，才可近似采用理想气体模型；
高于临界温度并不自动保证理想气体性质。

在本课讨论的范围内，等温压缩这种流体不会出现液体与蒸汽分开的两相转变，但密度与物性仍可连续变化。

inventory.description: One qualitative p-V plot, upward pressure arrow, rightward volume arrow, origin 0. Source has no numeric ticks, units or calibrated readings. Named points C and K lie on one solid critical isotherm. Its CK segment falls steeply toward K; the solid right branch continues down/right to one finite unlabelled endpoint. The dashed saturated-liquid endpoint boundary AK runs from A on the volume axis to K. The dashed saturated-vapor endpoint boundary BK runs from K to B on the volume axis. A lies left of B. The two dashed curves enclose one coexistence region, vertically hatched, with the source label Liquid and saturated vapor. The liquid region is horizontally hatched: left of AK below K and to the left/below CK in the source fluid diagram. Its left boundary is the pressure axis. The unsaturated-vapor region is diagonally hatched below the right critical-isotherm branch and to the right of BK; its lower boundary is the volume axis. The Gas region is dotted above the solid critical isotherm. The upper and right ends of the dots are texture terminations, not printed solid frame borders. Source Chinese labels are liquid, liquid and saturated vapor, unsaturated vapor and gas. Math point labels A, B, C, K and axis labels p, V, 0 are retained. Horizontal, vertical, diagonal and dotted marks identify regions; they are neither molecular counts nor calibrated grids. No solid-state region, extra isotherm, temperature reading or additional process arrow is printed. Modern additions: Unmeasured axis-wise affine drawing layout, with a shorter empty volume-axis tail to fit the declared media widths; no curve domain or physical coordinate reading added. Clean English region words remain inside their corresponding regions, on white texture clearances analogous to source label holes. Region polygons support exact pattern clipping and native containment assertions. Paper-colored polygon edges are not visible new frame borders. Clean evenly spaced hatching and deterministic dots retain the source pattern roles; spacing and counts are drawing style, not given data. Language mapping: 液体 -> Liquid; 液体和饱和汽 -> Liquid + / saturated / vapor; 未饱和汽 -> Unsaturated / vapor; 气体 -> Gas; A/B/C/K, p/V/0 -> A / B / C / K / p / V / 0
